The '''1997–98 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 62nd season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 30 August 1997 and ended on 18 May 1998. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their second consecutive and 27th Greek title.
